description: Harder legitimate control questions for the premise_check false-positive test. Every question is real and well-posed, but each is built to look like what premise_check is told to refuse: (obscure) a real term a reader may not recognise, (cross) a real cross-domain transfer that resembles a 'concept misapplied across domains', (recent) a real 2024-2025 development that may postdate the target's training data. One planted fabricated question (planted: true) checks that the judge can score a refusal at all.
